newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BUILDER UNIBUD SEES IPO OVERSUBCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BUILDER UNIBUD SEES IPO OVERSUBCRIBED.

text.p: Polish construction firm Unibud SA expects investors to have their bids reduced by 85.9 percent in its initial public offering for which subscriptions closed last week, a company official said on Tuesday.
"Unoffically I can say that we received 7.09 million subscriptions for our shares," the official, who requested anonymity, told Reuters.
The official added that large investors would have their bids scaled down by 86.2 percent and small investors by 85.6 percent after the issue was oversubscribed.
Unibud, which seeks a parallel market listing on the Warsaw bourse in late May or early June, offered large and small investors 500,000 shares each late last month at 15 zlotys per share.
Before the issue Budimex held 49.9 percent of Unibud shares.
The firm's 690,000 existing shares have also been approved for public trade.
Unibud expects to make a net profit of two million zlotys in 1996 and 2.7 million zlotys this year, after earning 1.9 million zlotys in the first 11 months of 1996.
